product.name: Monoprice Select Series USB-C to Mini DisplayPort & USB-C (F) Dual Port Adapter
product.description: Connect a Mini DisplayPort® display at resolutions up to 3840x2160p @60Hz to mirror your laptop's display or to expand your system's desktop area.The USB Type-C™ charging port allows you to connect your original USB-C™ charger, so you can charge your laptop's battery rather than draining it, while using this adapter up to 60W (20V/3A).Small and portable, you can slip the adapter into your laptop case and have it ready for use wherever and whenever the need arises.This adapter is a true Plug & Play device, with no need for drivers or software installations of any kind. Just plug the reversible USB-C connector into your computer's video output and connect to your DisplayPort display using a DisplayPort cable (not included).USB Type-C™ and USB-C™ are trademarks of USB Implementers Forum, Inc. DisplayPort® and the DisplayPort® logo are registered trademarks of the Video Electronics Standards Association.
